correctness.rationale: The Gill--Linusson/Torres exact H-representation proves all boundary halfspaces. Projecting each normal to the actual affine tangent subspace yields exact Euclidean clearances; summing each symmetric family gives sharp upper bounds attained at the uniform matrix. Equality of every minimizing family proves complete center loci and dimensions at all ranks, including k=m where row equalities change the intrinsic tangent space. The 175 independent small LP tests and exact integer critical checks corroborate rather than replace the universal proof. No open lemma is used.

For m<n, strict row/column scale separation gives an m(n-1)-dimensional high-rank locus; at k=m only rows become affine equalities, giving a second transportation-type center phase. Equality-margin transportation polytopes have a different affine hull and their own inradius is not the inradius of the encompassing k-assignment polytope. None dominates this rectangular theorem.

value.rationale: This is a natural complete classification for arbitrary rectangular fixed-cardinality assignment polytopes, with two genuinely different center-locus types and a sharp aspect-ratio suppression phenomenon. The high-rank nonterminal locus has affine dimension m(n-1), while at maximal matching rank the locus becomes a translated rectangular transportation polytope of dimension (m-1)(n-1). Infinite families have arbitrarily large center sets, while sufficiently wide rectangles have unique centers at every rank. These exact affine-geometric invariants are not addressed by previous facet, normality, face count or one-skeleton diameter results.
